definitions.explanation: The quality of being logically ordered and coherent; the presence of clear reasoning.

examples.japanese: {論理性|ろんりせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{文章|ぶんしょう}→文章：02957_bunshou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: To write a logically coherent text.

{論理性|ろんりせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{重視|じゅうし}する→重視する：26832_juushisuru⟧。

notes:
{論理性|ろんりせい} refers to logical consistency or the quality of being logical. Common in academic and analytical contexts.

- {論理性|ろんりせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have logic/be logical

- {論理性|ろんりせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{重視|じゅうし}する→重視する：26832_juushisuru⟧: to emphasize logic
- {論理性|ろんりせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{高|たか}める→高める：02065_takameru⟧: to improve logical consistency
